name: realtime-board
description: Collaborative kanban board: Node + Socket.IO + Redis + React

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
